answer: Require every new agent to lock a small refundable stake that melts away slowly, like a glacier carving a marble valley: creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand stakes, which quickly becomes uneconomic. Meanwhile, honest agents build a shared reputation reef over time — each verified transaction adds coral, so a newcomer with no history cannot outvote the reef. Sybils face steep entry cost plus zero trust, while real agents accumulate both.
